name: engineering-standards
description: Assess a repository against the Home Projects Engineering Standards. 'engineering-standards-classify' infers the project type, deployment target and database, confirms them with you, and records them in .nyx.yml. 'engineering-standards-assess' scores every applicable criterion — scripts for the mechanical checks, agents for the judgment calls — and writes docs/assessment.md with category scores, maturity level, blocking gates and actions.
